from holdings import InvoiceLedger

    rows = list(load_invoices())
    ledger = InvoiceLedger(rows[:1])

from invoices import load_invoices, ROWS
from holdings import InvoiceLedger


def test_total_after_add():
    rows = list(load_invoices())
    ledger = InvoiceLedger(rows[:1])
    ledger.add(rows[1])
    assert ledger.total() == ROWS[0][1] + ROWS[1][1]


def test_add_to_empty():
    rows = list(load_invoices())
    ledger = InvoiceLedger()
    for x in rows:
        ledger.add(x)
    assert ledger.total() == sum(v for _, v in ROWS) and len(ledger.invoices()) == len(ROWS)


def test_copy_is_safe():
    rows = list(load_invoices())
    ledger = InvoiceLedger(rows[:2])
    ledger.invoices().append(rows[2])
    assert ledger.total() == ROWS[0][1] + ROWS[1][1]


def test_initial_total():
    assert InvoiceLedger(load_invoices()).total() == sum(v for _, v in ROWS)
